triage.summary: Sarah Kim, practice manager for two dental clinics in Austin, asks whether Alex can build a website chatbot answering questions about cleaning prices, insurance and opening hours, and booking appointments in Google Calendar. She requests a rough cost and timeline.

task.title: Prepare a rough chatbot quote and timeline
task.description: Sarah Kim of two dental clinics in Austin asks for a website chatbot to answer questions about cleaning prices, insurance and opening hours, and book appointments in Google Calendar. Provide a rough cost and timeline.

reply.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for reaching out. I’d be happy to learn more about the clinics’ requirements and discuss a rough cost and timeline. Could you share how appointment availability and booking rules are managed today, and whether you have existing answers for the common questions?

Best,
Alex
